rationale: The agent executed order-changing actions (cancel_pending_order for two orders and return_delivered_order_items for the watch) without first confirming with the user, violating the explicit policy to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Although the agent appeared to identify the user via name and ZIP and then retrieved user and order details, there is no explicit confirmation step or preview prior to performing the cancellations/return. The final message also asserts refund routing to PayPal without showing confirmation of the refund method choice. Even if the amounts are correct, acting before confirmation fails the policy requirements.
